create_mpo_config: create an MPOConfig dataclass instance with custom batch size, discount, and critic type settings
configure_mpo_replay: configure MPO replay settings by setting replay_fraction, min_replay_size, and max_replay_size on MPOConfig
configure_mpo_optimizer: configure MPO optimizer settings by setting learning_rate, adam_b1, adam_b2, and weight_decay on MPOConfig
review_mpo_validation: review the MPOConfig __post_init__ method to understand validation rules for target update and replay settings
compute_samples_per_insert: compute an estimated samples_per_insert value from a given replay_fraction using _compute_spi_from_replay_fraction
